titles: Hannibal: The Man Who Nearly Destroyed Rome
How Hannibal Destroyed a Roman Army Twice His Size
Hannibal vs Rome: The Whole War in Maps
hook: In 216 BC, Rome sent the largest army in its history to destroy one man. By sunset it was gone. This is the full story of Hannibal Barca: the oath, the march over the Alps, Trebia, Trasimene, Cannae, fifteen years in Italy, and the final battle at Zama — told with animated maps and the ancient sources on screen.
